app.title: HD2 Font Maker
scope.mainGroups: These five choices are main game font groups, not the 14 interface languages. Emoji and decorative fonts use the separate option below.
weight.off:
Off: use the font's original weight.
All selected resources are replaced.
outline.on: On: repair outlines and clean edges.
outline.off:
Off: skip extra outline cleanup.
Some fonts may show blocks or rough edges.
preview.title: Font preview
preview.initial: Preview only; in-game rendering is not verified.
preview.missing: Missing preview characters will use original game glyphs during generation.
preview.ready: In-game size, color and background are controlled by the game.
preview.failed: Preview failed. Details are in frontend.log.
output.install: Deploy the generated ZIP with your mod manager.
output.changed: Settings changed. Generate a matching package before export.
status.imported: Font imported. Ready to preview or generate.
status.complete: Font ZIP generated. Open the output and deploy it with your mod manager.
status.exported_font: Original font exported unchanged. Share it only when its license permits.
dialog.face: Choose a face from this font collection
axes.weight_note: When matching game weights, this weight is the starting point for regular text.
error.title: Could not complete
error.no_font: Import or select a font first.
error.no_language: Select at least one game font group.
error.scope: Settings have changed. Generate a matching font package first.
error.axis_range: Enter numbers within the allowed ranges.
error.font_read: The font could not be read. Choose a valid TTF, OTF, TTC or OTC file.
error.font_changed: The imported font has changed. Import it again.
error.coverage: The font has no matching characters for the selected game font group.
error.output_location: Keep the font library, cache and output outside the game folder.
error.output_zip: Choose an output filename ending in .zip.
error.export_extension: Keep the original font's file extension when exporting.
error.cache: The file is missing or has changed. Generate the package again.
error.font_conversion: Font processing failed. Try another font or review the technical log.
error.atlas: Font texture generation failed. Review the technical log.
error.game: Game font resources could not be read. Check the selected game folder.
error.failed: The operation could not be completed. Review the technical log.
